title: BUFFET: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Few-shot Cross-lingual Transfer

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing the zero-shot and few-shot performance of large language models across 54 typologically diverse languages using the BUFFET benchmark to measure the significant performance gap and fairness issues between high-resource languages and under-represented or low-resource languages (e.g., indigenous and African languages).

Curating and evaluating models on both translation-based datasets and datasets annotated directly in the target language to account for and mitigate translation artifacts, unnatural topic distributions, and the failure to capture linguistic nuances of native speakers.
